q: "Alas! I have lost my wallet," he exclaimed.
o: He exclaimed with sorrow that he had lost his wallet.
He exclaimed alas that he had lost his wallet.
He exclaimed that he lost his wallet.
Exclaimed with grief he said that he had lost his wallet.
e: Exclamatory বাক্যের indirect speech করতে reporting verb বদলে যায়: আনন্দ বোঝালে exclaimed with joy, দুঃখ বোঝালে exclaimed with sorrow বা grief। এরপর inverted comma-র জায়গায় that বসে, reported speech-এর subject থাকে, আর verb-এর কাল অতীতের নিয়মে বদলায়। Alas! দুঃখ বোঝায়, তাই He exclaimed with sorrow that he had lost his wallet শুদ্ধ। Alas শব্দটি indirect-এ অবিকল রাখা বা কাল না বদলানো ভুল।

q: He has said to me, “I shall go out but you will stay.” Make it indirect speech.
o: He has told me that he would go out but I should stay
He has told me that he will go out but I shall stay
He told me that he will go out but I shall stay
He has said me that he would go out but I would stay
e: Reporting verb present perfect (has said) হলে reported speech-এর tense বদলায় না, শুধু person বদলায়। Said to হয়ে যায় told, তাই “has told me”। “I shall go” এর I হয় he, আর “you will stay” এর you হয় আমি (me-এর person অনুযায়ী) I। ফলে সঠিক রূপ: He has told me that he will go out but I shall stay। অর্থ: সে আমাকে বলেছে সে বাইরে যাবে কিন্তু আমি থাকব।

q: Arif said, “Hurrah! This time, we have won the game.” (Indirect)
o: Arif exclaimed with joy that that time they had won the game.
Arif exclaimed with joy that that time they have won the game.
Arif exclaimed with surprise that that time we had won the game.

q: Choose the direct speech of: 'He said that he would come the next day.'
o: He said, "I would come the next day."
He said, "I will come the next day."
He said, "I will come tomorrow."
He said, "He will come tomorrow."
e:
When we turn indirect speech back into direct speech, the tense moves one step forward and the time expression returns to its original form. 'Would' becomes 'will', 'he' becomes 'I', and 'the next day' becomes 'tomorrow'.
মনে রাখুন:
the next day → tomorrow
the previous day → yesterday
then → now, there → here

q: Change the narration: "Are you ready?" the doctor said to her children.
o: The doctor asked her children if they were being ready.
The doctor asked her children if they were ready.
The doctor asked her children if he was ready.
The doctor asked her children if it was ready.
e: Direct speech-এ "Are you ready?" একটি প্রশ্ন এবং auxiliary verb দিয়ে শুরু, তাই indirect করতে said বদলে asked বসে, আর quotation চিহ্ন সরিয়ে if বা whether আসে। প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন বাদ যায় এবং বাক্যটি সাধারণ বিবৃতির ক্রমে (subject আগে, verb পরে) সাজে। এখানে you বলতে ডাক্তার যাদের জিজ্ঞেস করছেন সেই সন্তানরা, তাই you বদলে they হয়। Reporting verb past হওয়ায় are বদলে were হয়। ফলে সঠিক রূপ: The doctor asked her children if they were ready. he, it বা were being ব্যবহার করলে ব্যক্তি বা tense ভুল হয়।
